text:
Sam: Heads-up — the Python SDK doesn't expose the admin/rate-limits list endpoint. Hit this while debugging the onboarding sample app, we only have curl routes in the docs.
Maria: Oh? which call did you try locally?
Sam: Tried `client.admin.rate_limits.list()` and got AttributeError. The REST route works: `curl -H \"Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/rate-limits?org_id=org_123\"` returns the JSON.
Jake: Hmm, sounds like that binding never made it into the generated client. Did we update the OpenAPI spec for admin routes?
Sam: Not sure. Also noticed the SDK retry behavior differs: REST returns 429 + `Retry-After` header, but SDK raises a generic RetryError and doesn't expose Retry-After, so our backoff is wrong and we hammer instead of waiting.
Maria: Can you paste a minimal repro and logs?
Sam: Sure — small snippet and logs:
```python
# repro.py
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY'))
client.admin.rate_limits.list(org_id='org_123')
```
Logs: `2026-03-21 09:12:02 ERROR request.py:429 RetryError: backoff exhausted (cause: 429) -- headers: {\"content-type\":\"application/json\", \"retry-after\":\"15\"}` -> SDK doesn't surface retry-after value.
Jake: Oof, two problems then: missing binding + retry header parsing. Quick win is to regenerate client from OpenAPI and add header handling to the RetryPolicy. I'll pick this up.
devex-bot: Issue created: DEVEX-3781 \"python-sdk: admin rate-limits missing + retry-after not surfaced\" — assigned to Jake. Link: https://redwood.internal/issue/DEVEX-3781
Amira: FYI we should also check the sample-app that shows rate-limit status to new users — it calls `get_rate_limits()` (different name) so param/return shape drift exists too.
Maria: Good call. I also noticed the REST payload returns `window_seconds` but the SDK models map it to `window` (int). That's a schema/param drift and will confuse clients.
Sam: That mismatch caused one of our onboarding demo failures: UI expected `window_seconds` and showed weird data.
Jake: I'll update the generated models to preserve server keys (or add aliases) and add a compatibility shim. Also add parsing so RetryPolicy reads `Retry-After` and exposes it via RetryError.retry_after.
Maria: I'll add a unit test in devex/sdk-tests that reproduces 429 with Retry-After and assert the SDK surfaces it. Also will patch the sample-app to call the canonical binding once Jake's PR lands.
Amira: Can we also sanity-check the TypeScript SDK parity? We don't want a TypeScript user to hit the same drift.
Jake: Yes — will run the OpenAPI gen for both SDKs and add a small parity checklist in the PR description. ETA EOD.
Sam: Thanks — leaving a short note in the customer ticket so support knows this is being tracked.
Jake: I'll post a follow-up when PR merges and add a small migration note in the CHANGELOG about `window_seconds` vs `window`.
Maria: :thumbsup: I'll handle the sample-app patch and add an integration test.
Sam: Appreciate it.
(brief pause)
Amira: Also, small ops note — when this hits prod, Dedicated customers might need a hotfix if their SDKs are pinned. I'll coordinate with release.
Jake: Copy. Will include release instructions in the PR and ping #release-war-room after merge.
